invalidations: Navigation/reload, lost page or main runtime/engine/context replacement invalidates collection; preserve prior observations with failure and start a fresh session.
Extra native contexts/static preview/dry audition refuse identity; never choose by sampleRate/name/order alone.
No callback, no AudioWorklet, pending/suspended enable, closed context, timeout, malformed reply or cleanup failure never becomes a live block/hearing PASS.
A historical valid histogram is historical callback evidence only; record its timestamp/state and do not claim current rendering if later collection failed.
